pages.title: Who Answers the Bell?
pages.text: Fill one Shade altar with Crystallized Blood, link its bell and summon its creature.

pages.title: Who Answers the Bell?
pages.text: Blood supplies later native altar charges and ghost lamps improve the summoning corner.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Choose Maw, Sword or Bat altar. The linked bell needs a nonempty charged altar and consumes charges. Full charge improves its initial summon; all three altars are optional.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Fill a Shade altar with Crystallized Blood and link a Shadow Bell. The bell controls summons; full charge improves initial Shades.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Fuel a Shade Altar with Crystallized Blood, then link Shadow Bell to it. Sword, Maw and Bat altars support distinct summons; Bell use depends on a linked, nonempty altar with charges.
